meta.title: Sana — my cycle
meta.description: Your Sana cycle tracker: the same data as in Telegram, on any device.

common.notContraception: Forecasts are not a method of contraception.

errors.futureDate: Future days can't be marked yet.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little.
errors.forbiddenOrigin: This address is not allowed by the server. Open the app at sanacycle.com.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.
errors.unreachableBody: Check your internet connection. Your data will appear as soon as Sana is reachable again.

sync.savedOffline: Will be sent when you are online
sync.dropped: {count, plural, one {# offline change} other {# offline changes}} could not be applied.
sync.explain: Changes from the Telegram bot and Mini App appear here automatically, and the other way round.

startConfirm.title: Is this a new period?
startConfirm.body: Your previous period started on {date}, less than 15 days ago. What is it?
startConfirm.continuationHint: It goes on: extend the previous period to this day
startConfirm.spottingHint: Light bleeding, doesn't start a new cycle
startConfirm.queuedBody: You marked a period start on {date} while offline. The previous one started on {prev}. What was it?

demo.banner: Demo mode: sample data, nothing is sent to Sana servers.
demo.telegramAuto: Demo: sign-in is confirmed automatically in a couple of seconds.
demo.loginHint: Demo: any email works, the code is 123456. Try new@…, period@…, late@… or pregnant@… for other states.

login.title: Welcome to Sana
login.subtitle: The same calendar as in the Telegram bot. Changes appear on both instantly.
login.telegramHint: We'll open the Sana bot: tap “Confirm” there and come back.
login.tgExpired: The link has expired. Try again.
login.errWidget: Telegram couldn't confirm the sign-in. Try again.
login.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes. Check the spam folder if it isn't there.
login.errInvalidCode: Wrong code. Check it and try again.
login.errExpired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
login.errTooMany: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
login.errWait: Please wait {sec} s before the next code.
login.legal: By continuing you accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

link.conflict: This sign-in method already belongs to another account and can't be linked automatically. Contact support.
link.sameData: Any sign-in method opens the same data
link.emailText: You'll be able to sign in with this email on any device, even without Telegram.
link.telegramText: Link the Sana bot to get reminders in Telegram and use the Mini App with the same data.

merge.title: Merge accounts?
merge.bodyEmail: This email already has its own Sana account.
merge.bodyTelegram: This Telegram already has its own Sana account.
merge.periods: {count, plural, =0 {No periods logged} one {# period logged} other {# periods logged}}
merge.what: We'll move its periods, day logs and symptoms into one account (the one with Telegram) and delete the other. Overlapping periods are joined.

onboarding.consentBody: Sana stores your cycle data to calculate forecasts.
onboarding.consent1: We never sell or share your data and show no ads.
onboarding.consent2: You can delete everything at any time in Settings.
onboarding.consent3: Forecasts are not a diagnosis or contraception.
onboarding.consentCheck: I agree to the processing of my health data under the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
onboarding.lastTitle: When did your last period start?
onboarding.lastHint: An approximate date is fine, you can change it later.
onboarding.periodTitle: How many days does your period usually last?
onboarding.cycleTitle: How long is your cycle usually?
onboarding.cycleHint: From the first day of one period to the first day of the next. Usually 21–35 days. Sana learns from your marks.

today.title: Today
today.lateDays: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
today.lateHint: A delay can be caused by stress, illness or travel. If pregnancy is possible, a test will help.
today.staleHint: It's been a long time since the last mark. Mark your last period to get forecasts again.
today.noDataHint: Mark the start of your period to get forecasts.
today.lowConfidence: The forecast gets more precise after 2–3 cycles
today.forecastNote: Forecast from your history. Not a method of contraception.

day.title: Day log
day.flowHint: Flow doesn't start or end a period by itself. Spotting doesn't start a cycle.
day.disclaimer: For self-observation only, not a diagnosis. For medical questions, see a doctor.
day.clearBody: Flow, pain, intimacy, symptoms and notes of this day will be deleted. Period marks stay.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.editHint: Tap days to mark or unmark your period. Future days can't be marked.
calendar.futureReadOnly: This is a forecast. Future days can't be marked; the forecast updates when you mark what actually happens.

install.title: Install the app
install.installed: Sana is installed on this device.
install.ios3: Open Sana from the home screen icon
install.other: Use “Install app” or “Add to Home screen” in your browser menu.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.periodDays: period {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
stats.empty: Statistics appear after two marked periods.

excluded.too_long: Not counted: unusually long (maybe a missed mark)
excluded.outlier: Not counted: very different from the others

stats.serverNote: Calculated by Sana servers, the same numbers as in Telegram.

settings.title: Settings
settings.forceLengthHint: Otherwise your history wins after 2+ cycles
settings.pregnancyText: Turn on to pause cycle forecasts and PMS/fertility notifications.
settings.pregnancyStartText: We count weeks from the first day of the last period. By default it's your last marked period.
settings.lmpPick: First day of the last period
settings.pregnancyEndText: Cycle tracking will resume. Choose what applies, if you want to.
settings.partnerText: Partner access is managed in the Telegram bot for now.
settings.logoutPending: {count, plural, one {# change hasn't} other {# changes haven't}} been sent yet and will be lost.
settings.logoutAllText: All website sessions will end, including this one. Telegram stays connected.
settings.deleteText: Your periods, symptoms, settings and partner links will be deleted forever, in Telegram too.

notifications.needTelegram: Reminders come from the Telegram bot. Link Telegram above to get them.
notifications.congratulateHint: When a new period is marked
notifications.discreetModeHint: No app name or the word “period” on the lock screen
notifications.pushSoon: Browser push notifications are coming later.
